plan.scope: Both complete original workloads; actual per-invocation file I/O remains inside all clocks.
plan.module_control: Only the final Scheme module is identical between native and its V8 control; Rust provider targets/linkage differ.
plan.exclusions: Exactly the first seven processes per workload are discarded in advance; no replacement samples.
plan.process_clock: Popen through capture, leader reap and bounded process-group cleanup, including post-exit checks.
plan.storage: OS file cache is uncontrolled and warmed by preparation/discard rounds; each retained sample is a fresh process.
